Phil Spivey opened up in 6th and as his throws improved to a best of 63.84 in round three, the opposition also improved and he was stuck with his position.

But it was in the throwing events that Belgrave made the best showing with Leith Marar taking the shot and discus and Phil Spivey having to launch his hammer to 65.10 to get the better of Sutton & District's Gareth Cook in a close competition.
